name: Aminata Diallo
scenario_title: A Walk to See School Bags
action: Aminata marks her place in the notebook and looks up at Fatoumata. "Wait for me a little. I will finish these last six problems, then we will go together. If we are choosing a bag, it should be one that will last the year."
reason: Aminata sees that she still has six problems left and that the lamp oil is not endless, but she also wants to help Fatoumata. Remembering the cheap bag that tore on her, she does not want Fatoumata to end up with something that fails before the year is over. That leads her to decide to finish a little more first and then go with her sister.
